statement: The Round-12 claim that the run-r12-delegated-3 manual cleanup archived wks_4fefe71e419da3b3 and wks_c12c0d706003413f has no durable archive record. The durable envelope only records workspaceCleanup.skipped=true reason=controller-not-terminal-or-still-alive with those two ids remaining. Round-13 inspected the live Paseo workspace inventory (94 active workspaces) and neither id is present, so the workspaces were indeed removed after the envelope was written; this is corroboration, not an archive receipt.
limitation: No archive command receipt exists for the manual cleanup; the absence from the live inventory is the strongest available evidence and is recorded as such.
